title: The Tabernacle Erected and God's Glory

questions.question: When was the tabernacle set up?
options: On the first day of the first month of the second year
questions.correctAnswer: On the first day of the first month of the second year
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:17 (ESV): "In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was erected."

questions.question: What filled the tabernacle when it was completed?
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:34 (ESV): "Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle."

questions.question: What appeared over the tabernacle by day?
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:38 (ESV): "The cloud of the Lord was on the tabernacle by day."

questions.question: What appeared over the tabernacle by night?
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:38 (ESV): "And fire was in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel."

questions.question: What did Moses put inside the ark?
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:20 (ESV): "He took the testimony and put it into the ark."

questions.question: Why could Moses not enter the tent of meeting?
options: Because the cloud settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: Because the cloud settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:35 (ESV): "Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle."

questions.question: When did the Israelites set out on their journeys?
options: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:36 (ESV): "Throughout all their journeys, whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the people of Israel would set out."

questions.question: What happened if the cloud did not move?
options: They did not set out till the day it was taken up
questions.correctAnswer: They did not set out till the day it was taken up
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:37 (ESV): "But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out till the day that it was taken up."

questions.question: Where did Moses place the lampstand?
options: In the tent of meeting on the south side, opposite the table
questions.correctAnswer: In the tent of meeting on the south side, opposite the table
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:24 (ESV): "He put the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle."

questions.question: What did Moses do after setting up the altar of burnt offering?
options: Offered the burnt offering and the grain offering
questions.correctAnswer: Offered the burnt offering and the grain offering
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:29 (ESV): "He set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance... and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering."

questions.question: What did Moses anoint with oil?
options: The tabernacle and everything in it
questions.correctAnswer: The tabernacle and everything in it
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:9 (ESV): "You shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it."

questions.question: Where did Moses and Aaron and his sons wash their hands and feet?
options: At the basin between the tent and the altar
At the entrance of the camp
questions.correctAnswer: At the basin between the tent and the altar
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:30-31 (ESV): "He set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar... and Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet from it."

questions.question: When did they wash at the basin?
options: When they went into the tent of meeting or approached the altar
questions.correctAnswer: When they went into the tent of meeting or approached the altar
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:32 (ESV): "When they went into the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed."

questions.question: What was visible to all of Israel throughout their journeys?
options: The cloud by day and fire by night on the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: The cloud by day and fire by night on the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Exodus 40:38 (ESV): "For the cloud of the Lord was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel throughout all their journeys."

key_verse_text: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
